title: Cross-person P300/ERP classification
current_best_explanation: No current global winner has been verified on this exact frozen input, split and scorer. A published dataset name or broad leaderboard lead is insufficient.
executed_endpoint: Brain Invaders 2012 calibration runs, 15 training and 10 test people; 16-channel 0–1 s epochs at 128 Hz with fixed baseline/reference/filtering; equal-person ROC-AUC.

existing_reference.name: Fixed time-bin shrinkage LDA and pyRiemann xDAWN specialist; H02 repeated-generation study is separate
existing_reference.evidence: A: locally executed references; repeats have their own training-only selection.
existing_reference.strength: xDAWN is directly suited to the ERP target and available channels.
problems: Within-session BI2012 accuracy leaderboards are not cross-person AUC.
Do not merge repeat-selected specialist or repeated programs into the one-shot result.
existing_reference.verification_scope: Only the named locally audited reference/archived outputs, not every newer candidate or equal-budget/global optimality.

candidates.name: xDAWN covariance → tangent-space SVM
candidates.evidence: B: relevant primary BI2012 benchmark family.
candidates.information_match: Exact epochs and training-person CV can be reused; no target-person fitting.

candidates.name: Riemannian Means Field classifier with xDAWN
candidates.evidence: B: primary P300 study; direct full text rate-limited.
candidates.information_match: Available ERP inputs fit; covariance regularization and training-only selection must be fixed.

candidates.name: CBraMod / REVE ERP fine-tuning
candidates.evidence: B: broad EEG models with primary benchmark context, not a BI2012 winner.
candidates.information_match: Possible raw EEG adaptation; resampling, short-epoch tokenization, channels, pretraining overlap and compute differ.

recommended_next_comparator: Train-person-selected xDAWN covariance/tangent-space SVM versus Means Field panel, selected by equal-person AUC; foundation-model arm only after ERP adapter validation.
switching_assessment: RETAIN xDAWN as a credible specialist and ADD current conventional contenders. Tier B. No evidence supports replacing it solely because a general EEG foundation model is newer.
limitations: Strong BI2012 published within-session results use a different split and metric.
Calibration-only selection and short epochs must remain unchanged.
No prevalence-dependent accuracy substitution for ROC-AUC.

evidence_tiers.A: Locally executed and audited on this frozen protocol; establishes a comparator result, not universal optimality.
evidence_tiers.B: Primary method/benchmark with relevant task evidence but an unmatched split, inputs, scorer or budget.
evidence_tiers.C: Author repository, preprint, mathematical proposal or adaptation requiring additional validation.
evidence_tiers.D: Unresolved access, unavailable artifacts or input mismatch precludes an executable recommendation.

execution_policy: Literature review only. No inference, fitting, new scores, checkpoint downloads, frozen protocol edits or result changes. Any new comparator requires a prospective amendment, frozen training-only selection and separate result records.
score_import_policy: No unmatched published numbers were imported into benchmark scores.
